αἰθέρ: αἰθήρ — the bright upper air, sky; masc. acc. sg., elided αἰθέρ’ (= αἰθέρα), object of ἵκανεν: ’the sky’
αἰθέρος: αἰθήρ — the bright upper air, sky; masc. gen. sg. (δι’ αἰθέρος ’through the upper air’)
αἰθρηγενέος: αἰθρηγενής — born of the clear sky (epithet of Boreas; sense not certain); masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
αὐδήν: αὐδή — voice, human speech; fem. acc. sg.
αὐτομέδων: Αὐτομέδων — Automedon, a companion of Achilles; masc. nom. sg.
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg.: ’of himself, him’ · also the adverb αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot’ · also intensive gen. sg. after a possessive, of the speaker: ’of myself’ (ἐμὸν αὐτοῦ ’my own’) · also intensive gen. sg. after a possessive, of a third person: ’his own’ (ἑῷ αὐτοῦ θυμῷ ’his own heart’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it’, ’upon it’ (ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ ’upon it’) · also gen. sg. standing for a thing, partitive after τὸ μέν: ’of it’ (τὸ μὲν αὐτοῦ ’one part of it’) · also gen. sg. standing apart from its noun: ’his’ (διὰ δ’ αὐτοῦ … ὀδόντων ’through his teeth’) · also gen. sg., object of ἀπήμβροτε: ’him’ (αὐτοῦ ἀπήμβροτε ’missed him’) · also gen. sg. standing for a neuter thing: ’from it’ (ἐκ … αὐτοῦ ’from it’)
αὐτόθι: αὐτόθι — on the spot, in that very place, right there; adv. (= Attic αὐτοῦ)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg., with the speaker: ’I myself’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a third person: ’she herself’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a second person: ’you yourself’
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg., as a plain pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ) · also intensive: ’himself’ · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with no preposition, indirect object: ’to him’ (ἥρμοσε … αὐτῷ ’fitted him’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a thing, with a verb of leaning: ’on it’ (αὐτῷ σκηπτόμενον ’leaning on it’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with ἔοικα: ’to him, like him’ (αὐτῷ … ἐῴκει ’resembled him’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a thing, of accompaniment with ἕπομαι, no preposition: ’with it’ (φρένες αὐτῷ ἕποντο ’the midriffs followed with it’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a person, of accompaniment with ἕπομαι, no preposition: ’him’ (ἕπετ’ αὐτῷ ’followed him’)
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
βάλετο: βάλλω — throw, cast; mid. throw on oneself, sling; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐβάλετο): ’slung (round himself)’
βορέαο: Βορέας (Βορέης) — Boreas, the North Wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic Βορέου)
βριαρήν: βριαρός — strong, heavy, weighty; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κόρυθα
βριθὺ: βριθύς — heavy; neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γένετ: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to be; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (γένετ’ = γένετο = ἐγένετο)
γέροντες: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. nom. pl.
γίγνετ: γίγνομαι — become, arise, come to be; pres. 3 sg. mid., elided (γίγνετ’ = γίγνεται): ’there is, there comes to be’ · also impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (γίγνετ’ = γίγνετο): ’came about’ (ἄραβος … γίγνετ’ ὀδόντων ’a clatter of teeth came about’)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γούναθ: γόνυ (pl. γούνατα) — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (γούναθ’ = γούνατα)
γυῖα: γυῖον — limb; neut. acc. pl., object of ἔλλαβε · also neut. acc. pl., object of λῦσε: ’loosed the limbs’ (λῦσε δὲ γυῖα) · also neut. acc. pl., goal of motion with δέδυκεν: ’has sunk into the limbs’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a passive: ’the limbs were loosened’ (λύντο δὲ γυῖα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject of an intransitive active verb: ’the limbs trembled’ (ἔτρεμε γυῖα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject of εἰμί with a predicate: ’the limbs were firm’ (ἔμπεδα γυῖα … ἦν)
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δίφρον: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. acc. sg. · also a seat, stool: ’stool’ (δίφρον … κατέθηκε ’set down a stool’)
δαιδαλέου: δαιδάλεος — skilfully wrought, cunningly made; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted ending
δαμῆναι: δαμάζω (δάμνημι) — subdue, overpower; aor. pass. inf.: ’to be overcome’, ’to be subdued’ (+ ὑπό + dat. of the agent)
δαναῶν: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. gen. pl.
δεύτερον: δεύτερος — second; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’a second time’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, of order in a sequence of attacks: ’second, next’ (δεύτερον ὁρμηθείς ’rushing second’)
δεῖπνον: δεῖπνον — meal, main meal; neut. acc. sg. of the goal: ’to the meal’ (ἐπὶ δεῖπνον) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’a meal’ (of horses, ’fodder’)
δι: διά — through; prep. + gen. or acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through’ (δι’ αἰθέρος ’through the sky’)
δοῦρα: δόρυ — beam, timber; also spear; neut. nom./acc. pl. δοῦρα, of a ship’s timbers · also δόρυ — spear; neut. acc. pl.: ’spears’ (ὀξέα δοῦρα ’sharp spears’) · also δόρυ — spear; neut. nom. pl., subject: ’spears’ (ὀξέα δοῦρα πεπήγει ’sharp spears were fixed’)
δύνατ: δύναμαι — be able; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (δύνατ’ = δύνατο), unaugmented (= ἐδύνατο), + inf.
δύσετο: δύω (mid. δύομαι) — enter, sink, set (of the sun), put on; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σετο, unaugmented (= Attic ἐδύσατο): ’set’ · also ’put on’ (τεύχεα … δύσετο ’put on his armour’)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῦν: δύνω (= δύω) — go into, put on; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided (δῦν’ = δῦνε; Attic ἔδυνε): ’put on’
δῶ: δῶ — house, home; indeclinable epic noun (= δῶμα), acc. sg., goal of motion after ποτί · also without a preposition, acc. of the goal after ἱκάνω: ’to the house’
δῶρα: δῶρον — gift; neut. nom. pl. · also neut. acc. pl., object of διδοῖς: ’gifts’
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom · also εἰ γάρ + opt., introducing a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ γὰρ … εἴην ’if only I were’) · also εἰ γὰρ δή + indic.: ’if indeed’ (εἰ γὰρ δὴ μέματον ’if you two are indeed eager’)
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’took up (for himself)’
εὖτε: εὖτε — when; epic temporal conj. (= Attic ὅτε)
ζεφύροιο: Ζέφυρος — the West Wind, personified; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ζεύγλης: ζεύγλη — yoke-loop (the exact part of the harness is not certain); fem. gen. sg., of separation with ἐξεριποῦσα: ’from the yoke-loop’
ζυγὸν: ζυγόν — yoke; neut. acc. sg., after ὑπό in tmesis with ἤγαγεν: ’under the yoke’ · also neut. acc. sg., after ὑπέρ: ’over the yoke’ (ὑπὲρ ζυγόν) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of ἦεν (the yoke of a lyre): ’a yoke’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of ἐέργει: ’the yoke’ (ζυγὸν … ἐέργει ’the yoke keeps (them) apart’) · also neut. acc. sg., after παρά: ’beside the yoke’ (παρὰ ζυγόν)
θέτο: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἔθετο): ’put (for himself)’
θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., possessive with μῆνις: ’a god’s (wrath)’ · also gen. governed by ἄνευθε(ν): ’without a god’ · also gen. possessive with πληγῇ: ’a god’s (blow)’
θεός: θεός — god; nom. sg. (also ’goddess’, θεός being common gender)
θεὰ: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’goddess!’
θοάων: θοός — swift, quick; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), agreeing with νηῶν
θωρήσσοντο: θωρήσσω — arm with a breastplate; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic -σσ- (= Attic θωρήττω): ’armed themselves’
θώρηκα: θώραξ — breastplate, cuirass; masc. acc. sg., epic θώρηκ- (= Attic θώρακα)
κάμε: κάμνω — toil, labour, grow weary; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκαμε): ’toiled’ (κάμε τεύχων ’toiled at making’) · also with a direct object: ’made, wrought’ (πάνθ’ ὅπλα κάμε ’made all the arms’)
καιομένοιο: καίω — burn; pres. part. mid./pass. neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with θεείου: ’burning’
καλοῦ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. gen. sg.
καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. acc. pl. as an adverb, with a negative: ’not well’ (οὐ … καλὰ ’not fairly’) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔντεα: ’fine (gear)’
καλὰς: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. acc. pl.
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’) · also + acc., ’according to, after’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’after one’s heart’) · also κατὰ ἶσα ’equally, evenly’ (κατὰ ἶσα μάχην ἐτάνυσσε) · also + acc. of the part of a weapon: ’at’ (κατὰ στόμα ’at the tip’) · also + acc., ’through, out along’ (κατὰ ῥῖνας ’out through the nostrils’) · also + gen., ’down into’ (κατὰ γαίης ’down into the earth’) · also κατὰ πάμπαν, adverbial: ’altogether, utterly’
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’) · also ἤ κεν + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὅππως κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’how … may’ · also ὄφρά κεν + subj., purpose: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρά κεν ἔλθητον ’so that you two may come’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’as long as’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … κεν ὁρᾷ ’as long as he sees’) · also ἐπεί κεν + fut. indic., in a temporal clause: ’as soon as’ (ἐπεί κεν … παραλέξομαι ’as soon as I shall lie beside’)
κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κνήμῃσιν: κνήμη — shin, lower leg; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
κνημῖδας: κνημίς — greave, leg-guard; fem. acc. pl.
κολλητὸν: κολλητός — glued, fitted together; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ξυστόν: ’glued’
κορυφῆς: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. gen. sg.
κορύσσετο: κορύσσω — arm, helm, equip; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’armed himself’
κραταιή: κραταιός — strong, mighty; fem. nom. sg., with μοῖρα
κρατὶ: κάρη (κράς) — head; neut. dat. sg. (stem κρατ-): ’on the head’
κρονίων: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, Zeus; masc. nom. sg., by-form of Κρονίδης
κτύπος: κτύπος — crash, thud, din (of hoofbeats); masc. nom. sg.
κῦδος: κῦδος — glory, the lustre of success granted by a god; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition: ’glory’
λήξω: λήγω — cease, leave off, end; fut. 1 sg. act.: ’I shall end’
λίην: λίαν — very much, exceedingly; adv., Ionic λίην (= Attic λίαν)
λίπετ: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. imper. 2 pl., elided (λίπετ’ = λίπετε): ’leave’ · also λείπω — leave; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (λίπετ’ = λίπετο), passive sense: ’was left’
λαβὼν: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’, ’having seized’
λαμπέσθην: λάμπω — shine, gleam; impf. 3 dual mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἐλαμπέσθην), with the dual subject ὄσσε: ’the two shone’
λαμπρὸν: λαμπρός — bright, shining; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’brightly’
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the people’
λευκώλενος: λευκώλενος — white-armed; adj., nom. sg. (epithet of women, e.g. Nausicaa)
λητώ: Λητώ — Leto, mother of Apollo and Artemis; nom. sg.
λόφον: λόφος — crest, plume (of a helmet; also a ridge); masc. acc. sg. · also nape, neck: ’neck’ (κνήμας τε ἰδὲ λόφον ’shins and neck’)
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also neut. nom. sg., elided (μέγ’ = μέγα), with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ ἔρισμα ’a great cause of strife’) · also neut. acc. sg., elided, with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ εὖχος ’great cause to boast’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial with a superlative: ’by far’ (μέγ’ ἄριστος ’by far the best’)
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγας: μέγας — great, big; masc. nom. sg.
μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj. · also ’lest’ with the opt. (μή … δευοίατο ’lest they lack’) · also ’lest’ with a dual verb in -ετον: ’lest the two … hang back’ · also the negative of an infinitive in an oath: ’never to’ (μή ποτε … ἐπιβήμεναι)
μαντεύεαι: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; pres. 2 sg. mid. dep., epic -εαι (= Attic μαντεύῃ)
μείλινα: μείλινος — of ash-wood; neut. acc. pl.
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great chamber; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
μελίην: μελίη — ash tree; ash-wood spear; fem. acc. sg., Ionic (= Attic μελίαν)
μεμαυῖαν: μάω (perf. μέμαα) — be eager, strive; perf. part. fem. acc. sg., present sense: ’eager’ (no Attic equivalent)
μενεαίνων: μενεαίνω — be eager, rage; pres. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’eager, furious’
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis · also + acc. in μετὰ νῶτα βαλών: ’behind, with the back turned’ · also + acc. of direction: ’to, back to’ (μετὰ νῆας ’to the ships’) · also + dat. of place: ’in’ (μετὰ φρεσί ’in the mind’)
μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ), with an imperative: ’and do not’ · also with an optative of wish: ’and let … not’ (μηδ’ ἔτι … εἴην ’and may I no longer be’) · also with a hortatory subj.: ’and let us not’ (μηδ’ … ἀμβαλλώμεθα ’and let us not put off’) · also μηδ’ εἰ ’not even if’, before a condition with the indicative · also with an infinitive after a verb of bidding: ’and not to’ (μηδ’ ἐξέμεν ’and not to let go’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μοῖρα: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg. · also with an inf., ’it is fated’ (μοῖρα θανεῖν ’fated to die’)
μόρος: μόρος — doom, appointed fate (esp. death); masc. nom. sg.
μώνυχας: μώνυξ — solid-hoofed, with an undivided hoof; masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ἵππους
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νέκταρ: νέκταρ — nectar, the gods’ drink; neut. acc. sg. (nom. identical)
ναύτῃσι: ναύτης — sailor; masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ναύταις)
νεῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl. (= epic νηῶν)
νηῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl., epic νηῶν (= Attic νεῶν)
νυ: νυ — now, then; weak enclitic particle (= νῦν, Attic νυν)
νόσφι: νόσφι — apart, aside; adv., also prep. + gen. ’apart from’ (νόσφι λιασθείς ’withdrawn apart’)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νῶϊ: ἐγώ — I; pron., 1st pers. dual nom., epic νῶϊ (= Attic νώ): ’we two’ · also dual acc.: ’us two’
ξάνθέ: Ξάνθος — Xanthus (’Chestnut’), name of one of Hector’s horses; masc. voc. sg. Ξάνθε, accented before the enclitic τε
ξίφος: ξίφος — sword; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., as subject (ξίφος ἄγη ’the sword was broken’)
οἰοπόλῳ: οἰοπόλος — lonely, solitary (οἶος + πέλομαι; formation not certain); adj. of two endings, masc. dat. sg., agreeing with χώρῳ
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’) · also masc. nom. pl. in the correlative οἳ μὲν … οἳ δέ: ’some … others’
οἴχονται: οἴχομαι — be gone, have gone; pres. 3 pl. with perfect force: ’have gone’
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg. · also οἶος printed for οἰός (οἶς) — sheep; gen. sg. οἰός: ’of a sheep’ (οἰὸς ἄωτος ’sheep’s wool’)
οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her, to himself’ · also masc. nom. pl. demonstrative, printed with this accent (= οἳ): ’they’ (οἷ δ’ ἐγρηγόρθασι)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκέτι: οὐκέτι — no longer, not any more; adv.
οὐρανοῦ: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. gen. sg.
οὐρανὸν: οὐρανός — heaven, sky; masc. acc. sg.
οὖδας: οὖδας — ground, earth, floor; neut. acc. sg.
πάλλειν: πάλλω — brandish, swing; pres. inf. act.: ’to swing’
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’) · also adv. of anticipation: ’first, sooner’ (πάρος … δώσω ’I will give first’) · also prep. + gen.: ’before’ (Τυδεΐδαο πάρος ’before the son of Tydeus’) · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also with a future, ’first, before that’ (πάρος … καθέξει ’first … will hold’)
πάτροκλον: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. acc. sg.
παμφαίνων: παμφαίνω — shine brightly, gleam; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’gleaming’

πατρόκλου: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ companion; masc. gen. sg.
πατρώϊον: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, ancestral; neut. acc. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’

πηλιάδα: Πηλιάς — of Pelion, Pelian; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with μελίην
πνοιῇ: πνοιή — breath, blast, breeze; fem. dat. sg.
ποιμένα: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. acc. sg. (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’, apposition)
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ποσσὶν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic double σ (= Attic ποσί)

προμάχοισι: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’) · also in πρὸς ἰθύ ’straight toward’, with ἰθύ adverbial · also + acc., ’against’ (πρὸς δαίμονα ’against a divinity’)
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πτερὰ: πτερόν — feather, wing; neut. acc. pl. (nom. pl. also)
πυκινὸν: πυκινός — thick, close-set, solid; masc. acc. sg.: ’solid’ · also masc. acc. sg., of a plot: ’close-woven, cunning’ (πυκινὸν δόλον ’a cunning trap’) · also neut. acc. sg., of a word: ’shrewd’ (πυκινὸν ἔπος ’a shrewd word’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with νέφος: ’dense’ (πυκινὸν νέφος ’dense cloud’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with λέχος: ’solid’ (πυκινὸν λέχος ’a solid bed’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with νόον: ’shrewd’ (πυκινὸν νόον ’shrewd mind’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄχος: ’heavy, thick’ (πυκινὸν ἄχος ’heavy grief’)

πόντοιο: πόντος — sea; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. acc. sg.
πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (same form): τοῦτο πόρε ’give this!’
πᾶσα: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg., with χθών · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔπαλξις: ’the whole (of it)’ · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with Ἴλιος: ’all (of Ilios)’ · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἣ (the head): ’all of it’ (ἣ … πᾶσα ’the whole of it’)
πῆλαι: πάλλω — brandish, swing; aor. inf. act. (epic πῆλαι), complementing ἐπίστατο: ’to swing’

σάκεος: σάκος — shield; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
σάκος: σάκος — shield; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’the shield’ (σάκος … ἀνεδέξατο ’the shield received’)
σέλας: σέλας — light, gleam, flash; neut. nom./acc. sg.

σμερδαλέον: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’terribly’
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
σταθμῷ: σταθμός — steading, farm-building, stall; masc. dat. sg., after ἔνι (ἔνι postpositive): ’in the steading’
στενάχοντο: στενάχομαι (στενάχω) — groan, lament; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they groaned’
στιβαρόν: στιβαρός — stout, massive, sturdy; neut. nom./acc. sg.
στρατόν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.

τέκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔτεκε)
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’) · also neut. nom. sg. agreeing with ἔγχος after εἴ: ’any’ (εἴ τί τοι ἔγχος ’if any spear of yours’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆδος after εἴ: ’some’ (εἴ πέρ τί σε κῆδος ἱκάνει ’if some concern reaches you’) · also neut. acc. sg. indefinite, agreeing with ἔπος: ’some (word)’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεθνηῶτα: θνῄσκω — die; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic τεθνεῶτα): ’dead’
τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα) · also neut. acc. pl., elided: ’armour’ (τεύχε’ ἀπούρας ’having taken the armour’)
τεύχεσι: τεῦχος — (pl.) armour, gear; neut. dat. pl.
τεύχων: τεύχω — make, fashion; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’making’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τούς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’, accented before the enclitic γε
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition, working as a relative: ’who’ (ἄνδρεσσι … τοὶ Ἰλίῳ ἐγγεγάασιν ’the men … who were born in Ilium’)

τρυφάλεια: τρυφάλεια — helmet (origin of the word not known); fem. nom. sg.
τρωσὶν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’

τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’)

φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλου: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with πατρός
φίλων: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. pl. · also attributive with ἑτάρων: ’dear (companions)’ · also substantive, ’loved ones’, in a phrase with πατρίδος αἴης (τῆλε φίλων ’far from loved ones’)
φίλῳ: φίλος — dear, beloved, one’s own; adj., masc. dat. sg.
φαεινὴν: φαεινός — bright, shining; fem. acc. sg. (epic by-form of φανός)
φράζεσθε: φράζομαι — consider, take thought, take heed; pres. imper. mid. 2 pl.: ’consider’
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φόνον: φόνος — murder, slaughter, bloodshed; masc. acc. sg.
χ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); elided and aspirated χ’ before a rough breathing; with the opt., potential: ’would’ · also with the subj. after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ χ’ … πύθηαι ’if you ever hear’)
χάλκεον: χάλκεος — of bronze; neut. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦν) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος: ’of bronze’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος: ’of bronze’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕπνον: ’of bronze’ (χάλκεον ὕπνον ’a bronze sleep’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οὐρανόν: ’of bronze’ (χάλκεον οὐρανόν ’the bronze heaven’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄπα: ’bronze’ (ὄπα χάλκεον ’bronze voice’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with δόμον: ’of bronze’
χαίτη: χαίτη — long hair, mane; fem. nom. sg.
χαλκοῦ: χαλκός — bronze, copper; masc. gen. sg.: πλεῖαι χαλκοῦ ’full of bronze’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on δοῦπος, of material: ’of bronze’ (δοῦπος … χαλκοῦ ’the din of bronze’)
χείρων: Χείρων — Chiron, the wise centaur, healer and teacher; masc. nom. sg.
χθὼν: χθών — earth, ground; fem. nom. sg.
χρή: χρή — it is necessary, there is need; impersonal, + acc. of the person (and gen. of the thing needed)
ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’) · also neut. nom. pl., in apposition (ἀγλαὰ τέκνα ’splendid children’)
ἀείρας: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lifted’
ἀθήνην: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; fem. acc. sg.

ἀμφιέποντες: ἀμφιέπω — be busy about, attend to, ply; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’busying themselves about’

ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.

ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’) · also with ὡς + subj. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … τιμήσομεν ’so that we may honour’)

ἄλλως: ἄλλως — otherwise, in another way; adv.

ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.

ἐλάσαι: ἐλαύνω — drive; aor. inf. act., used as an imperative: ’to drive’
ἐλέησε: ἐλεέω — pity, have compassion on; aor. 3 sg. act., + acc.: ’pitied’

ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — in this place, to this place; adv.

ἐξεριποῦσα: ἐξερείπω — fall down out of, drop out; 2nd aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., + gen. of separation: ’dropping down from’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπίστατο: ἐπίσταμαι — know, know how to; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἠπίστατο)
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπισφυρίοις: ἐπισφύριον — ankle-piece, ankle-clasp (of a greave); neut. dat. pl.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐρατεινὴν: ἐρατεινός — lovely, delightful; adj., fem. acc. sg.
ἐρινύες: Ἐρινύς — Erinys, Fury (avenging spirit); fem. nom. pl.

ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’)
ἐσπάσατ: σπάω — draw, pull out; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐσπάσατ’ = ἐσπάσατο): ’drew out’
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’) · also + gen., ’over, around’ (ἐφ’ ὁμίλου ’over the crowd’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐφ’ ἱπποπόλων Θρῃκῶν ’toward the horse-herding Thracians’)
ἐχέοντο: χέω — pour; mid. pour oneself, stream; impf. 3 pl. mid., uncontracted: ’poured out’
ἐϊκυῖα: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐϊκυῖα (= Attic ἐοικυῖα): ’like’
ἑοῖο: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ἑῆος: ἑός — one’s own (possessive of any person); masc. gen. sg., epic ἑῆος; sometimes taken as gen. of ἐύς ’good’
ἔβαλον: βάλλω — throw, cast, put down; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they cast out’ · also ’hit, strike’: ’they struck’ · also σὺν … ἔβαλον in tmesis (= συνέβαλον): ’they joined, brought together’ (σὺν … ἔβαλον πόλεμον ’joined war’)
ἔδυνεν: δύνω (= δύω) — put on, enter; impf. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable): ’put on (armour)’
ἔθειραι: ἔθειρα — hair; mane of a horse, plume of a helmet; fem. nom. pl.: ’plumes’
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔκταν: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 pl., root aorist ἔκταν (= Attic ἔκτειναν): ’they killed’ · also aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔκταν’ = ἔκτανε): ’he killed’
ἔλειπον: λείπω — leave, leave behind; impf. 1 sg. (the form is also 3 pl.): ’I left’
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
ἔντεσι: ἔντεα — armour, gear; neut. pl., dat. -εσι: ’in armour’
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔσχεθον: ἔχω — hold, check; aor. 3 pl., epic by-form (= Attic ἔσχον): ’they held’
ἔφατο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἔφη): ’he spoke’
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., opponent after μάχομαι: ’with Hector’; and after χωρέω: ’to Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. after a verb of anger: ’with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with ὑπό, of those before whom men flee: ’before Hector’
ἕλοντο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἵλοντο): ’took (for themselves)’
ἕο: reflexive pron. (= ἑαυτοῦ, Attic οὗ) — himself; gen. sg., gen. of comparison after a comparative: ’than himself’ · also gen. sg. after ἀπό: ’from herself’ (ἀπὸ ἕο ’away from herself’)
ἕταρον: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
ἠΰκομος: ἠΰκομος — fine-haired, epithet of goddesses and women; fem. nom. sg.
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠλέκτωρ: ἠλέκτωρ — the sun (the usual explanation; meaning not certain, perhaps ’the beaming one’); masc. nom. sg., epic (Attic ἥλιος): ’like the sun’
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl.: ’we’
ἡνιοχῆα: ἡνιοχεύς — charioteer, driver (by-form of ἡνίοχος); masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
ἡρώεσσιν: ἥρως — hero; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ἥρωσιν)

(grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’
ἤμυσε: ἀμύω — sink, droop, bow down (stem and sense taken from the context; uncertain); aor. 3 sg. act.: ’drooped’
ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’whom’; not the possessive · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν — her own; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’her own’ (θυγατέρα ἥν ’her own daughter’)
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἥφαιστος: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἦτορ: ἦτορ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. of respect: ’in heart’ (βεβλαμμένον ἦτορ ’stricken in heart’)
ἰάχων: ἰάχω — cry out, shout; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic: ’crying out’
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰχθυόεντα: ἰχθυόεις — fish-filled, teeming with fish; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόντον
ἵει: ἵημι — send, let go, throw; impf. 3 sg.: ’sent’ · also ἵημι — put, set; impf. 3 sg., with ἐν: ’put in’ (ἐν … ἵει ’put in (the traces)’)
ἵκανε: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg.: ’came to, reached’
ἵκανεν: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’came to’
ἵκηται: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid. (short ι; subjunctives take no augment)
ἵκοιτο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, arrive; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a general clause: ’(whenever) he came’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., of wish: ’may he come’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’)
ἵπποιιν: ἵππος — horse; masc. gen./dat. dual, epic -οιιν (= Attic -οιν): ’of the two horses’
ἵπποισιν: ἵππος — horse; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic ἵπποις)
ἶφι: ἶφι — mightily, by force; adv. (instrumental -φι of ἴς)
ἷκε: ἵκω — come, arrive at, reach; impf. 3 sg. (= ἷκεν), with long ι: ’reached’
ὀδυρόμενος: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’lamenting’
ὀλέθριον: ὀλέθριος — destructive, deadly; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἦμαρ
ὀλέσθαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. inf. mid.: ’to perish’
ὀμφαλόεσσαι: ὀμφαλόεις — bossed, with a central boss (ὀμφαλός); fem. nom. pl., epic -σσ-
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὀρθοκραιράων: ὀρθόκραιρα — straight-horned; adj., fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), with βοῶν · also fem. gen. pl., agreeing with νεῶν: ’straight-horned (ships)’
ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄπιθεν: ὄπιθεν — behind, from behind; adv., with the directional suffix -θεν
ὄρεσφι: ὄρος — mountain (epic οὖρος); neut. pl. in -φι(ν), ablatival/locatival (= Attic gen. ὀρῶν or dat. ὄρεσι): ’down the mountains’
ὄρνυτο: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, rush; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ὤρνυτο): ’rose, rushed’
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνε): ’urged on’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’urge on!’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’)
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’)
ὑψόθ: ὑψόθι — on high, aloft; adv., elided (ὑψόθ’ = ὑψόθι; = Attic ὑψοῦ)
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤμοιιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual gen., epic -οιιν (= Attic ὤμοιν): ’from the shoulders’ · also masc. dual dat., of place with εἱμένος: ’about the shoulders’ (ὤμοιιν νεφέλην ’a cloud about the shoulders’)
ὤμοισιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ὤριστος: ἄριστος — best, noblest (superlative of ἀγαθός); masc. nom. sg., crasis ὁ ἄριστος (ὤριστος): ’the best’
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ᾤχετο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go, have gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented (οἰ- → ᾠ-): ’had gone’ · also of continuous motion, ’went about, kept going’ (κατὰ πτόλιν ᾤχετο πάντῃ ’she went everywhere throughout the city’)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥιπῆς: ῥιπή — rush, swing, force (of a throw); fem. gen. sg.
